properties.note: #479 (merged 94f1fa68) memoised the betweenness and the adjacency per write generation; design_regions returns in 12.5 s on the debug daemon it was measured on, and in 5.5 s cold / 2.0 s warm on a release build. The >300 s observation is wholly false now and this ChangeEvent is what made it so. NOT drawn to the sibling finding (fact:design-regions-is-one-expensive-region-walk-per-seed-…) because that one is only half false — there are still 109 seeds and one walk each; what changed is that the walk is no longer rebuilt from scratch — and a partially superseded finding stays open.
